title: Cyble records 56 ransomware incidents in Indonesia in 2026, up from 30 in 2025
date_note: Both pages give only their publication day (27 November 2026); the report's own date was not seen.
summary: Medcom reports that Cyble Research and Intelligence Labs recorded 56 ransomware incidents in Indonesia from January to 23 November 2026, against 30 cases in 2025 and 16 in 2024. Selular reports the same Cyble count and says government and law enforcement were the most targeted sector. This is Cyble's tally as relayed by the press.
plain: Security firm Cyble counted 56 ransomware incidents in Indonesia so far in 2026, compared with 30 in 2025 and 16 in 2024, according to Indonesian media.
exec: Cyble's count of 56 ransomware incidents in Indonesia in 2026, versus 30 in 2025, points to rising ransomware pressure there, per Medcom.
